name: override-test-and-gut-check
description: Run the override test: if the matrix says X but your gut says Y, investigate the gap. The gap usually means either (a) you left out a criterion that your gut is weighting, (b) you weighted something wrong, or (c) your gut is responding to information that is hard to quantify. Do not override the matrix without naming the reason. Do not follow the matrix if your gut strongly disagrees without investigating why.
